command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git diff --name-only | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1; test "$(git diff --name-only)" = 'docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md'; git add docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; git commit -m 'Update Phase 3 field blocker recovery status'; NEW=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo committed_sha=$NEW; git push origin HEAD:main; test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')" = "$NEW"; echo PHASE3_GUIDE_UPDATE_PUSH_PASS
